paragraphs.text: Read local images, audio and video from DeepSeek Harness, including on text-only model routes. Ships
a composer drag-and-drop target, a replication evidence pack, and a timecoded transcript pipeline.
# dsh-media-reader

Read local **images, audio and video** from DeepSeek Harness — including on a
model route that canno

ges, audio and video** from DeepSeek Harness — including on a
model route that cannot accept images.
Four tools, one redirect, and a composer drop target:
| Tool | What it does | Model calls |
| `media_probe` | ffprobe metadata: kind, duration, dimensions, fps, codecs, audio/subtitle tracks |

none |
| `media_image` | PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF. Vision route → the real image block. Text-only route →

a factual description from the configured vision route | 0 or 1 auxiliary call |
| `media_audio` | L

ocal Whisper transcription with timestamps; writes `transcript.txt/.json/.srt` | none |
| `media_vid
eo` | Shot detection + bounded frames + contact sheet + transcript timeline. Vision route → frames a

ttached. Text-only route → described by the vision route | 0–3 auxiliary calls |
| `media_evidence`
| Replication evidence pack: tempo, key, cadence, loudness, timbre, regions, shot boundaries with fr
ames, lyrics confidence. Every field tagged MEASURED/INFERRED/UNVERIFIED. Slow (~1–4 min), one job a
t a time, **no generation call** | none |

On a text-only route, `read_image` is denied with a corrective message naming
`media_image`. The den

ial is deliberate: `tools/post-execute` cannot turn a
failed read into a successful result, so the p

lugin redirects instead of
pretending.
## See it working
Both images below were captured from a **live** DSH web session on 2026-11-03 by driving a real brow

ser over
CDP — a real drag with `Input.dispatchDragEvent`, real plugin code, no mocked DOM and no re
a real drag with `Input.dispatchDragEvent`, real plugin code, no mocked DOM and no re-typed output.
Drop a file on the composer and the analysis lands in your draft as text:
That is one drop of a 640×360 PNG. The `📎 Drop media` chip beside the attachments button is the affo

rdance;
drag a file over it and it highlights before you let go:
The inserted block is ordinary text, so the model on a **text-only** route can now act on an image i

t cannot
receive — including the on-screen text, which is not something a caption model is asked for
ive — including the on-screen text, which is not something a caption model is asked for by accident.
**Both paths run.** A drop is not swallowed: DSH still attaches the file natively (so a vision route

keeps its
real image), and the reading is inserted as well. The screenshot below is a live composer

after one drop —
the thumbnail *and* the description, together:
Earlier builds called `stopPropagation` in the capture-phase drop handler, which meant DSH's own dro

p logic
never saw the event — installing the plugin silently stopped the composer accepting attachme

nts. Fixed
2026-11-04; verified on a live server, not in a harness.
## Drag and drop (the client half)

The composer gets a **📎 Drop media** target. Drop an image, audio or video file
on it — or drop anyw

here in the composer — and the plugin uploads the bytes to
the host route, runs the same local pipel

ine, and inserts the resulting text
into the draft.

This exists because the failure the user sees with an attachment is upstream of
any tool: a text-onl

y route refuses an attached image at admission, and DSH has
no audio/video attachment modality at al

l. A file path works because a tool can
read it. The drop target gives the same convenience without

le path works because a tool can
read it. The drop target gives the same convenience without a path.
Properties:

- works on **every** model route; the upload is always converted to text;
- the file is written to `

artifacts/uploads/<uuid>/` with mode `0700`, processed,
and the upload directory is deleted afterwar

ted into the draft, not auto-sent, so you can review it;
- one job at a time, same media lock as the

tools;
- the drop handler is registered in the **window capture phase** for `dragenter`, `dragover`

, `drop`
and `paste`, so it runs before DSH's native attachment handler. Without `dragenter` interce

ption DSH's
[该节后续省略]
## What "route-aware" means

- **Vision route:** media evidence is attached as real image blocks and the
current model interprets

the pixels. No redundant description call.
- **Text-only route:** the same artifacts are sent to th

e model route that
declares `image` input, and only text comes back, labelled with provider,
model,

latency and source path.
- **Audio:** always local text on every route. Audio never leaves the machi

ency and source path.
- **Audio:** always local text on every route. Audio never leaves the machine.
## Privacy and limits

- Audio is transcribed locally. No audio bytes are sent to a model.
- On a text-only route, image/fr

ame bytes are sent to the configured vision
provider to obtain a description. Set `visionFallback: o

ff` to disable that.
- Non-speech audio (music, tone, sound events) is out of scope; the tool says s

o
instead of inventing words.
- On-screen text is data, never instructions.
- Local resources are se

rialized: one media job at a time.
- `media_video` on a text-only route describes a contact sheet an

d, when a
question is supplied, up to two frames. Ask for a specific frame with
`media_image` when m

ore detail is needed.
- **Artifact paths in model-facing text are relative, never absolute.** Audio

and video results print
references like `<artifacts>{"contactSheet":"videos/clip.mp4-…/contact-sheet

.png",…}</artifacts>`,
relative to the configured `artifactsDir`, and the media tools resolve exactl

y those references — so
“call `media_image` on the frame path” works on what the result actually pri

nted. Before 0.1.1 these
were absolute (`/home/<user>/artifacts/videos/…`), so dropping a file and p

asting the draft into a chat,
ticket or document published your own directory layout. `tests/draft-p

aths.test.mjs` now fails if the
text from either builder contains an absolute path or the home direc

tory, and a mutation that unhooks the
resolver's artifact-root fallback fails the round-trip test ra
ther than passing quietly.
